PROJECT 02 / NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING

TWINEVALAI

A semantic evaluation system that compares the meaning of written answers using sentence embeddings instead of relying only on exact keywords.

[ THE PROBLEM ]

COMPARE MEANING, NOT COPYING.

Written answers can be correct even when their wording differs from a reference answer. Keyword matching misses that nuance and rewards repetition over understanding.

TwinEval transforms both answers into semantic representations, measures their closeness, and returns a similarity signal that can support faster academic review.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

TEXT TO SEMANTIC SCORE.

01 / INPUT

COLLECT ANSWERS

Receive a reference answer and the learner's written response.

02 / ENCODE

BUILD EMBEDDINGS

A Sentence Transformer maps both texts into meaning-aware vectors.

03 / COMPARE

COSINE SIMILARITY

Vector direction is compared to estimate semantic alignment.

04 / PRESENT

RETURN A SIGNAL

The interface displays a readable score for human-supported evaluation.
